tasks.label: IGVC: Open simulation scenario
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch igvc_bringup bringup.launch.py use_sim:=true

tasks.label: IGVC: Open non-SLAM simulation scenario
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch igvc_bringup bringup.launch.py use_sim:=true use_slam:=false

tasks.label: IGVC: Open input keyboard
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash; gnome-terminal --title 'Teleop twist keyboard' -- sh -c 'ros2 run teleop_twist_keyboard teleop_twist_keyboard --ros-args -r cmd_vel:=/bot_drive_controller/cmd_vel -p use_sim_time:=true -p stamped:=true' -norc

tasks.label: IGVC: Open RTAB
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash; ros2 launch igvc_slam igvc_slam.launch

tasks.label: IGVC: Open Nav2
tasks.command: source install/setup.bash; ros2 launch igvc_nav igvc_nav.launch.py
